items.t: STI piston ringland failure
items.job: Replace short block or engine assembly
items.note: Shops often quote close to $10,000 all-in for a replacement engine; a used engine costs less but carries risk.

items.t: WRX piston ringland failure
items.job: Replace short block or engine assembly
items.note: Labor hours are for the same engine family in the STI.

items.t: Rod bearing knock and spun bearings
items.job: Replace short block or engine assembly
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $5,200 on average. Ask about the Subaru extended coverage on 2012-2017 cars.

items.t: Excess sealant can reach the oil pickup
items.job: Remove oil pan, clean pickup screen and reseal
items.note: Estimate only; if bearings are already damaged, engine replacement costs far more.

items.t: Carbon buildup on intake valves
items.job: Walnut-blast clean intake valves
items.note: Hours vary with intake manifold removal.

items.t: Timing belt breaks or jumps a tooth
items.job: Replace timing belt kit and water pump
items.note: If the belt already broke, bent valves can turn this into a head or engine repair.

items.t: Oil leaks at the front of the engine and AVCS faults
items.job: Replace cam seals or AVCS oil control valve
items.note: Cam seals are usually done along with the timing belt to save labor.

items.t: Check engine light from the knock sensor
items.job: Replace knock sensor

items.t: Misfires from worn spark plug wires
items.job: Replace spark plug wires and plugs

items.t: Clutch slips, shudders or wears out early
items.job: Replace clutch kit and resurface or replace flywheel
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,800 on average.

items.t: Five-speed manual grinds or pops out of gear
items.job: Rebuild manual transmission
items.note: A used transmission can cost less than a rebuild.

items.t: STI six-speed grinds in fifth or sixth gear
items.job: Replace transmission synchros

items.t: Judder or vibration when accelerating through turns
items.job: Perform bulletin repair for turn judder
items.note: Normally covered by the new-car warranty.

items.t: Fuel line can leak on cold starts (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel line per recall
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Turbo oil supply pipe can crack (recall)
items.job: Inspect and bracket or replace turbo oil supply pipe
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Turbo intake duct can crack (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace turbo intake duct
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Crankcase vent (PCV) system fix (emissions recall)
items.job: Repair PCV system per emissions recall
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Replacement airbag inflator may be fitted wrong (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reinstall passenger inflator kit
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake lines can rust through (recall)
items.job: Inspect, rust-proof and replace brake lines as needed
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake light switch can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Replacement ignition switch can slip out of Run (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace ignition switch
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup light switch can corrode (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace backup light switch
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Trunk subwoofer wiring can short (recall)
items.job: Add wire retainer clip and replace subwoofer if needed
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake switch fault can disable EyeSight braking (recall)
items.job: Reprogram EyeSight driver assist
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front driveshaft joint can crack (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front driveshafts
items.note: Free at any Subaru dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Battery drains when the car sits
items.job: Test parasitic draw and replace 12V battery

items.t: Windshield cracks easily
items.job: Replace windshield
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,100 on average.

items.t: Check engine light for the EVAP purge valve
items.job: Reprogram engine computer
items.note: Normally free under warranty.

items.t: Rattle or flutter from a cracked front exhaust pipe
items.job: Replace front exhaust pipe with updated part
items.note: Normally covered by warranty when it applies.

items.t: Touchscreen flashes, freezes or shuts off
items.job: Update head unit software; replace display if needed
items.note: Software updates are usually free under warranty.

items.t: Popping or clicking from the front struts in turns
items.job: Replace front strut mounts

items.t: Driver-assist false warnings or cruise control dropouts
items.job: Inspect and recalibrate EyeSight cameras

items.t: Satellite radio ads pop up on the screen while driving
items.job: Check for infotainment software update
items.note: No known repair; listed for a software check only.
